summary: Ice Climber entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Ice Climber
entries.definitive_edition: NES version through Nintendo Switch Online/Nintendo Classics

emulation.emulator: Mesen / FCEUX only if official route is unavailable
emulation.notes: Use official Nintendo Classics route where possible; document emulator/core if used.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original NES/Famicom hardware or accurate NES emulation

primary.version: NES version through Nintendo Switch Online
primary.why: The NES version is the most practical official route for the core Ice Climber game through Nintendo's current classic-game service. The VS. arcade release has meaningful stage/content differences, so it is logged as a comparison route rather than folded into the NES recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the NES version through Nintendo Switch Online/Nintendo Classics. Record service version, controller, region, save-state/rewind use, co-op state, and whether VS. Ice Climber was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Compare only if documenting the arcade branch.
secondary.why: The arcade version is not identical to the NES route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original arcade branch with different content/difficulty behavior.
all_releases.reason: secondary: compare for arcade branch coverage.
primary: main official route through current Nintendo Classics access.

all_releases.platform: Virtual Console / Game Boy Advance / e-Reader and other rereleases
all_releases.reason: skip: useful if already owned, but not better than current Nintendo Classics route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: NES and VS. arcade branches differ; use NES for the main route and arcade for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record save-state/rewind use and do not merge VS. Ice Climber branch differences into the NES run.
